name: mi-tarjetica-launch
description: Mi Tarjetica — video de lanzamiento (keynote) + historias y publicaciones para redes

scripts.render:hero: remotion render MiTarjeticaHero out/mi-tarjetica-hero.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=18 --audio-bitrate=192k && bash scripts/master-audio.sh out/mi-tarjetica-hero.mp4
scripts.render:vertical: remotion render MiTarjeticaVertical out/mi-tarjetica-vertical.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=18 --audio-bitrate=192k && bash scripts/master-audio.sh out/mi-tarjetica-vertical.mp4
scripts.render:hero:4k: remotion render MiTarjeticaHero out/mi-tarjetica-hero-4k.mp4 --scale=2 --codec=h264 --crf=18 --audio-bitrate=192k && bash scripts/master-audio.sh out/mi-tarjetica-hero-4k.mp4
scripts.music: python3 scripts/make-music.py && remotion ffmpeg -y -i public/music/cama.wav -b:a 192k public/music/cama.mp3 && rm public/music/cama.wav
